mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 5.0% signals economic deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures indicate broad demand weakness, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 110 (index 2017=100) signals supply-side contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 110, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in employment growth supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without additional conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1700 thousand units indicate weakening residential demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 1700, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate and unemployment rate signal monetary tightening amid economic weakness, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE rise, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP level exceeding 11000 billion dollars indicates near-capacity economic activity, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 > 11000, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
